card.name: Body positioning in instructions
card.fires_on: Words in how-to or first-aid instructions where the next word is likely to describe a body posture or placement, such as sit, stand, position or place. It fires on linking words and verbs just before such a phrase.

modes.label: Handling steps
modes.description: Step-by-step device or product instructions where the next words tell the user to position or hold something.
modes.example: Move the hair away from the scalp so that one of the affected areas is exposed.<< Position>> the bottle over the lesion.

modes.label: Posture advice
modes.description: Instructions to sit, lie down, or position oneself, or to move a person away.
